summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expansion found one mega-cap reference leader and three US-listed underfollowed/small-cap discovery candidates with plausible direct or adjacent exposure. GE Vernova is the obvious context anchor for utility-scale HVDC/FACTS/STATCOM systems. American Superconductor is the most direct underfollowed US-listed STATCOM/FACTS pure-play candidate via D-VAR. Allient is a lower-attention harmonic-filter and power-quality component candidate through its TCI/Allient Power offerings. Preformed Line Products is not a FACTS/HVDC systems supplier, but is included as an adjacent high-voltage transmission hardware and substation/connectivity beneficiary whose utility qualification/stickiness profile resembles the node bottleneck. Layer 1B expands the US-listed universe around the HVDC/FACTS and high-voltage power-quality node. The best direct US-listed underfollowed fit found in this pass is AMSC, because its D-VAR product is explicitly a STATCOM/FACTS solution for voltage stability, renewable interconnection, and grid reliability. PLPC and POWL are second-order grid buildout suppliers: not pure HVDC/FACTS vendors, but they sit in constrained physical grid hardware and engineered electrical distribution systems where utility qualification, reliability, and project-cycle stickiness may matter. GEV is included only as a reference anchor because it is a direct HVDC/FACTS leader but is mega-cap and highly visible.
